product.summary: TokenPocket's current mobile multi-chain decentralized wallet product.

events.title: TokenPocket Wallet officially released
events.description: TokenPocket's first-party announcement history records the formal release of TokenPocket Wallet on 2018-02-13.
events.notes: The source provides an exact first-party formal release date. Canonical product wlr_prod_000079 is corrected from unresolved launch_date to 2018-02-13 with day precision in this promotion.

events.title: TokenPocket iOS 2.0.6 added Bitcoin and Dogecoin support
events.description: TokenPocket's 2023-04-14 mobile update documented iOS version 2.0.6 with Bitcoin and Dogecoin support, Bitcoin Taproot support, custom nodes, Nostr support, and additional wallet-management improvements.
